job_description:
Junior Product Designer

We are looking for a junior product designer to support our design team. You will help with wireframes, prototypes, and usability testing under mentorship.

Requirements:
- Portfolio showing wireframes and prototypes
- Exposure to Figma and user research
- Eagerness to learn design systems and product design
notes: Product-design discipline at entry-level seniority; thin intern/coursework resume against a junior design JD. Resume band 70-84 is the thin-resume tier and the heuristic scores 86 - two points high, inside the calibration tolerance. Triage (#118): heuristic under-penalisation, not a mis-assigned band. The scorer has no experience-depth dimension, so five section headings (the only fixture with a Projects section) plus an easy echo of a junior JD lift an intern resume above both non-backend senior fixtures and three of the five mid-level ones. The band stays at the tier the resume belongs to rather than being widened to cover the overshoot. Match band 84-100 is high on purpose: a junior candidate against a junior JD really is a close keyword match.
